items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Desi Arnaz was making Cuban Pete and he invite me to the studio and he give me a sightseeing to the studio. He was very nice to me.

ctx.x: Yeah, sightseeing. I went to Hollywood. In that particular time, Desi Arnaz was making Cuban Pete and he invite me to the studio and he give me a sightseeing to the studio. He was very nice to me.
Okay. At that time, Macho, were there any other Latin bands in California, that were popular, playing Afro-Cuban music?
